newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jews want Vatican to withdraw "antisemitic" stamp.
newsitem.headline: Jews want Vatican to withdraw "antisemitic" stamp.

text.p: The Simon Wiesenthal centre on Friday asked the Vatican to withdraw a postage stamp based on a seven-century old print depicting Jesus confronting Jews wearing the pointed hats of a mediaeval ghetto.

The centre's European bureau in Paris, in a letter to the Vatican commission on Judaism, said the headgear was "discriminatory and the direct precursor to the Nazi yellow star" which Jews were made to wear during World War Two.
It asked the Vatican to withdraw the 2,500-lire stamp as encouraging antisemitic prejudice and violating the standards of the Universal Postal Union.
